name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart - 单个Campaign详情页趋势图（按日Dim）
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart。场景：在Campaign详情页查看单个campaign的按日(Dim=date)趋势图，通过CampaignId+ReportDateTime筛选。样本中占比29.2%(146次)，为最高频场景。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart - 按Campaign状态筛选的汇总趋势图（Dim=ytd）
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart。场景：Campaign列表页按状态(enabled/paused)筛选，查看汇总期间(ytd)趋势图，无标签/组合等其他筛选。样本中占比11.2%(56次)。

steps.name: 按状态筛选的汇总趋势图

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart - 按状态+标签筛选的趋势图
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart。场景：Campaign列表页按状态(enabled/paused)+自定义CampaignTagId标签组合筛选，查看趋势图(Dim=ytd)。样本中占比11.0%(55次)。

steps.name: 按状态+标签筛选的趋势图

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart - 按名称搜索+状态筛选的趋势图
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart。场景：Campaign列表页按名称关键词(LikeOr)搜索并叠加状态筛选，查看趋势图(Dim=ytd)。样本中占比6.0%(30次)。

steps.name: 按名称+状态筛选的趋势图

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart - 无筛选查看全部Campaign整体趋势图
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart。场景：不带任何campaign维度筛选(仅日期区间)，查看账户下全部campaign的整体趋势图(Dim=ytd)，对应默认打开列表页无过滤条件的场景。样本中占比4.4%(22次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart - 按广告组合(Portfolio)+状态筛选的趋势图
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignChart。场景：Campaign列表页按所属广告组合(PortfolioId)+状态筛选，查看趋势图(Dim=ytd)，用于组合维度的业绩追踪。样本中占比2.8%(14次)。

steps.name: 按组合+状态筛选的趋势图

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList - 按campaignId+campaignState+日期范围查询campaign列表
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList。用户在campaign列表页选中特定campaignId后，按启用状态(CampaignState)和日期范围过滤查询campaign明细数据，按周(Dim=week)聚合。样本中占比32.6%(151/463次，符合Swagger结构的有效样本)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList - 按campaignId+日期范围查询campaign列表（不筛选状态）
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList。用户选中campaignId后仅按日期范围查询campaign明细数据，不额外筛选campaign状态，按天(Dim=date)聚合。样本中占比17.7%(82/463次，符合Swagger结构的有效样本)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList - 按campaignId+campaignName模糊搜索+campaignState+日期范围查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList。用户在campaign列表页通过名称模糊搜索(CampaignName Like)结合campaignId、campaignState(多状态enabled+paused)和日期范围查询campaign明细，按周(Dim=week)聚合。样本中占比16.0%(74/463次，符合Swagger结构的有效样本)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList - 按campaignId+campaignState+广告类型(CampaignTypeItems)+日期范围查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList。用户按campaignId、campaignState(多状态)结合具体广告类型子分类(CampaignTypeItems，如SponsoredDisplay/SponsoredTV细分)和日期范围查询campaign明细，按天(Dim=date)聚合。样本中占比7.8%(36/463次，符合Swagger结构的有效样本)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList - 按campaignId+campaignName模糊搜索+日期范围查询（不筛选状态）
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignDetailList。用户按campaignId结合名称模糊搜索(CampaignName LikeOr)和日期范围查询campaign明细，不筛选campaign状态，按周(Dim=week)聚合。样本中占比5.2%(24/463次，符合Swagger结构的有效样本)

steps.name: 按campaignId+campaignName模糊搜索+日期范围查询

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData - 按指定CampaignId精确查询单个广告活动效果数据
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData。用户在广告活动详情/选中若干CampaignId后，仅按CampaignId过滤+日期范围(date维度)查询效果数据，无对比周期。样本中占比27.8%(139/500次)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData - 按状态筛选并附带同期对比查询广告活动列表
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData。用户按CampaignState=enabled筛选广告活动列表，并选择了同期对比区间(StartCompare/EndCompare)查看趋势。样本中占比11.6%(58/500次)

steps.name: GetCampaignPageData - 按状态+对比周期查询

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData - 按名称搜索并按状态筛选广告活动列表
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData。用户在搜索框输入CampaignName模糊搜索并叠加CampaignState多状态(enabled,paused)筛选广告活动列表。样本中占比9.4%(47/500次)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData - 按状态和标签组合筛选广告活动列表
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData。用户按CampaignState=enabled + CampaignTagId(标签)组合筛选广告活动列表，并附带同期对比区间。样本中占比8.8%(44/500次)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData - 无附加筛选条件的默认列表查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData。用户未添加任何筛选条件，仅指定日期范围查看全部广告活动默认列表（页面初次加载场景）。样本中占比4.2%(21/500次)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData - 按广告类型(CampaignTypeItems)筛选广告活动列表
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageData。用户按广告类型CampaignTypeItems(如SB-Video)筛选广告活动列表，并附带同期对比区间。CampaignTypeItems相关组合样本占比5.6%(28/500次)，本case取其中一条典型样本(该具体组合4/500次)

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize - 按效果指标筛选条件查询广告活动列表
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize。用户在Campaign列表页设置字段筛选条件（如ROAS阈值>=2）查询符合条件的广告活动，不叠加tag/campaignIds/portfolio/campaignType等其他筛选维度。样本中占比38.2%(118次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize - 无筛选条件的默认活动列表查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize。用户不设置任何自定义筛选条件，仅按投放状态(states)和服务状态(servingStatus，如CAMPAIGN_OUT_OF_BUDGET预算超支)浏览默认的广告活动列表。样本中占比21.0%(65次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize - 按campaign标签(Tag)筛选查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize。用户按已打的campaign标签(taggingIds)筛选查询广告活动列表，不叠加其他筛选条件。样本中占比17.8%(55次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize - 按指定campaignIds批量精确查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize。用户直接传入一批具体的campaignIds（如从其他页面勾选后跳转）批量查询这些广告活动的明细数据。样本中占比5.8%(18次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize - 按广告类型明细(CampaignTypeItems)筛选查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize。用户按广告类型明细(CampaignTypeItems，如sponsoredProducts手动投放)筛选广告活动，常与tag、字段筛选条件组合使用。样本中占比8.1%(25次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize - 按广告组合(Portfolio)筛选查询
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignPageDataMaxPageSize。用户按广告组合(portfolioIds)筛选查询该组合下的广告活动列表，常与campaign标签筛选组合使用。样本中占比8.7%(27次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景1_勾选指定Campaign汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户在Campaign列表中勾选指定的CampaignId查看汇总数据（date维度，单日）。500条随机样本中占比27.2%(136次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景2_按CampaignTag标签筛选汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户按CampaignTagId(标签)筛选campaign查看汇总数据。500条随机样本中占比20.6%(103次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景3_按Campaign名称搜索汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户按CampaignName模糊搜索并叠加默认CampaignState状态筛选查看汇总数据。500条随机样本中占比18.8%(94次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景4_默认总览_State筛选_同期对比
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户未做额外筛选，仅按默认CampaignState查看campaign汇总数据，并叠加同期对比日期(StartCompare/EndCompare)。500条随机样本中占比17.2%(86次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景5_按投放状态ServingStatus筛选汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户按Amazon投放状态ServingStatus(如CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLED/ENABLED)筛选campaign查看汇总数据。500条随机样本中占比9.4%(47次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景6_按Portfolio筛选汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户按PortfolioId筛选campaign并叠加CampaignState查看汇总数据。500条随机样本中占比8.0%(40次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景7_按广告类型CampaignTypeItems筛选汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户按广告类型CampaignTypeItems(如SP手动/自动投放)筛选campaign查看汇总数据，并叠加同期对比日期。500条随机样本中占比5.6%(28次)。

name: POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal - 场景8_按目标Asin筛选汇总
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/Campaign/GetCampaignTotal。用户按投放的商品Asin(CampaignAsin)筛选相关campaign查看汇总数据。500条随机样本中占比3.4%(17次)，独立业务意图(按商品定位campaign)予以保留。
